# Scrub Lab

> > Premium ultra-soft medical scrubs and healthcare uniforms for professionals, featuring innovative SLTECH™ fabric technology and sustainable charitable partnerships.

Scrub Lab is an Australian medical apparel retailer specializing in high-quality scrubs for healthcare workers. The brand offers curated product lines (ELIZABETH, FLORENCE, LUCY, IAN, VICTOR) with proprietary SLTECH™ antimicrobial fabric, corporate bulk solutions, and supports World Youth International health initiatives.

## Key Topics

- SLTECH™ antimicrobial fabric
- Medical scrubs
- Healthcare uniforms
- Women's scrubs
- Men's scrubs
- ELIZABETH scrub top
- LUCY jogger pants
- Premium fabric technology
- Corporate uniforms
- Maternity scrubs
- Compression socks
- Custom embroidery
- Limited edition collections
- Underscrubs
- Sustainable healthcare apparel
